{"predictors": [
    {"name": "Debt Maturity Structure", "construction": "Ratio of long-term debt to total debt", "rationale": "Firms with longer debt maturity may be less likely to face financial distress, leading to higher stock returns.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
    {"name": "R&D Intensity", "construction": "Ratio of research and development expenses to total sales", "rationale": "Firms that invest more in R&D may have higher growth prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
    {"name": "Dividend Payout Consistency", "construction": "Number of consecutive years a firm has paid dividends", "rationale": "Firms with consistent dividend payouts may be seen as less risky, leading to higher stock returns.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
    {"name": "Employee Satisfaction", "construction": "Change in employee count", "rationale": "Firms that retain employees may have better management and higher productivity.", "higher_returns_for": "Low values of the measure"},
    {"name": "Product Market Competition", "construction": "Herfindahl-Hirschman Index calculated from industry sales data", "rationale": "Firms in less competitive industries may have higher profit margins.", "higher_returns_for": "Low values of the measure"},
    {"name": "Capital Expenditure Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of capital expenditures over the past five years", "rationale": "Firms with more stable investment are likely to be less risky.", "higher_returns_for": "Low values of the measure"},
    {"name": "Tax Rate", "construction": "Total tax expense divided by pre-tax income", "rationale": "Firms with lower tax rates may have higher after-tax profits.", "higher_returns_for": "Low values of the measure"},
    {"name": "Inventory Turnover", "construction": "Cost of goods sold divided by average inventory", "rationale": "Firms with higher inventory turnover may have better operational efficiency.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
    {"name": "CEO Tenure", "construction": "Number of years the current CEO has been in position", "rationale": "Longer CEO tenure may indicate stable leadership and predict higher future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
    {"name": "Foreign Sales Ratio", "construction": "Foreign sales divided by total sales", "rationale": "Firms with higher foreign sales may benefit from global diversification.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"}
]}
